What's New in Version 2.9.0 🚀
- Accidental Time Addition & Deduction: Add missed study time or deduct accidental timer sessions & break times with real-time sync across all insights, heatmaps, and charts.
- Reworked Habit & Goal Planner: Completely reworked daily goals and habits checklist with seamless state management and zero screen flickering.
- Improved Stability & Bug Fixes: Enhanced database consistency, improved developer suite, and major performance optimizations.
